lead_headline: Restaurant tracker posts twelfth consecutive zero-lead day as June shutdown extends into second full weekend

restaurant.blurb: Twelfth straight day without new leads—Sunday extends June freeze to 288 hours as detection machinery logs second consecutive weekend with zero activity across all Denver neighborhoods.

liquor.blurb: Day 37: Sunday extends June licensing blackout—Colorado's application freeze reaches 37th consecutive day with zero filings, zero status changes across 12,396 tracked licenses. The unprecedented regulatory shutdown now owns June's first full week as state machinery maintains complete silence through second weekend. May's paralysis hardened into June gridlock with no signs of thaw as Sunday posts month's seventh straight zero-activity day. The invisible backlog compounds while licensing apparatus logs longest documented freeze in modern Colorado history.

reputation.blurb: Three mentions yesterday as Saturday coverage included 76ers president hire (Facebook), Aurora apartment query (Reddit), $9.5M Cherry Hills sale (Denver Post). Weekly total: 37 pickups across 10 sources, down 16% from prior week's 44 mentions. Denver Post led with 8 citations, Facebook contributed 7, Reddit and Instagram tied at 5 each. Week-over-week decline snaps multi-week plateau as media attention cools entering second June weekend. Google News RSS continues driving 100% of discovery.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled)—Saturday's modest gain lifts MTD net to +10 (+1.7/day), 90-day net to +129. Past two weeks show volatile pattern: May 26-28 delivered net +11, May 29-June 4 posted ten-day freeze, then June 5-6 recovered with net +5 across two days. Recent 7-day span (+11) outpaces prior week (+9) as June shakes off opening paralysis, though Saturday's single-subscriber gain suggests cooling momentum after Friday's net +4 surge. YTD pace (+1.3/day) trails current MTD velocity as month enters first full weekend with uneven but positive trajectory.
